[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 3 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]25 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4.25) |spawned_by = [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frozen''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. It can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Compared to the [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]], the '''Frozen''' had slightly higher health and slightly faster speed. Upon its death, the [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] had a chance to spawn the '''Frozen'''. ==Appearance== The '''Frozen''' has light blue skin. Its torso and legs are baby blue. The '''Frozen''' has no facial features. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *Placing down two [[Pyromancer]]s on both sides of the path near the portal is recommended, as these can severely weaken hordes of '''Frozens''', along with any [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowies]] that spawn. **As the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage (normal damage is kept the same), it can be very effective against '''Frozens''' at later upgrades. ***Be aware that early on, two [[Pyromancer]]s is not sufficient to kill all the '''Frozens''' that spawn. You can eventually upgrade the [[Pyromancer]]s to Level 3 in order to clean up all the '''Frozens''' that appear. **Towers like [[Minigunner]] and [[Crook Boss]] can clear up any remaining '''Frozens''' that spawn. *Because the '''Frozen''' spawns in hordes, towers that deal damage to multiple enemies can be extremely useful in dealing with the '''Frozen'''. **Splash damage towers, like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]], can also be used. *The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] can be very useful in stalling these enemies. **As the '''Frozen''' spawns in hordes, the [[Electroshocker]] can be useful in stalling many '''Frozens'''. **The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and Level 3 [[Sledger]] can freeze the '''Frozen''', giving towers more time to attack it. *As the base health on [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is 200, and the '''Frozen''' has 25 health, it is fine to let some through. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFrozen.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Frozen''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrozenIconIG.png|'''Frozen''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was very similar to the [[Frozen (Village of Despair)|Frozen]] from the [[Christmas 2019 Event]], except that its head shape is slightly different. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3]] **'''Frozen''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frozen''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Frozen''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Frozen]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} Has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} '''Frozen''' no longer breaks, as it now has health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{FrostInvasion|[[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]]|Wave 1|Frozen|Wave 3|[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)|Cold Mist]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Frozen}}
